prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Save Your Companion to Your Account", "body": "Signing in anchors your pet to this account so your progress and custom pets are never lost across sessions.", "hint": "Make sure to use the same login method each time to retain your pet.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Account Protection Active", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Preview and Verification Screen: Insert a new verification screen before generating the final pet certificate to let users preview custom photo rendering results.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_preview_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_preview_check": {"headline": "Preview Your Custom Desktop Companion", "body": "Check how your pet render looks before completing adoption.", "button_label": "Confirm & Adopt", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Subflow: Add an interactive walkthrough sub-flow at the end of onboarding demonstrating how to show, hide, and summon the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls_walkthrough"], "new_desktop_controls_walkthrough": {"headline": "Master Desktop Controls", "body": "Learn how to toggle visibility in your system tray and interact with your pet anytime.", "button_label": "Finish Setup", "layout": "checklist"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Post Pet Customization: Move sign-in after pet choice and customization so users build emotional investment before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Wait Time and Status Tracker: Display a progress bar and accurate remaining time estimate on the waiting screen while pet assets render in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "body": "We are generating your desktop pet graphics and background setup."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Clarification Copy: Rewrite headlines and choice descriptions to clearly distinguish quick preset pet adoption from custom photo pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Pick a quick ready-made companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom desktop friend.", "hint": "You can add more pets later from your settings."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Technical Guidelines Hint: Add clear image requirements and framing advice hints to the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit photos with clear subject backgrounds for best rendering results."}}
7: [finish, hint] System Tray Desktop Controls Callout Hint: Provide explicit instructions on finding the app icon in the system tray to control or unhide the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to show, hide, or tweak settings anytime."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Split Card Layout for Path Selection: Reformat the choose_path screen into a side-by-side split visual card layout.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split"}}
9: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Notification Option: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the window while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen clearly without removing required steps or violating design guidelines.
Adds a custom pet preview screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps intact.
Adds an interactive desktop controls tutorial subflow after the home intro within onboarding.
Reorders sign-in to take place after pet selection/customization, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adds an accurate time estimate and progress tracker to the waiting screen.
Clarifies choices on the path selection screen while retaining both adopting and custom pet creation options.
Adds helpful framing guidelines to the photo upload screen without altering its job.
Adds system tray guidance hint to the home intro screen within onboarding.
Reformats the path selection screen into a split layout while maintaining its functionality.
Adds a desktop notification alert option to the waiting screen inside onboarding.
